ideas.title: Internal Parts Commerce OS MVP
ideas.one_sentence_value: Create a usable internal workflow for part intake, location, pricing, listing and order state before building a public marketplace.
ideas.target_buyer_or_user: used parts seller / internal warehouse operator
ideas.pain: parts are hard to locate, price, list and control without a structured OS
ideas.revenue_path: improves own inventory monetization first, later becomes seller software or marketplace foundation
ideas.margin_logic: software asset and internal efficiency; direct cost low, build time must be tracked
ideas.first_test: define data model and run 20 real parts through the workflow

ideas.title: External Model Review Layer
ideas.one_sentence_value: Use Claude or other strong models as controlled second-opinion reviewers for architecture, code and product gates.
ideas.pain: single-model blind spots can miss issues, alternatives or architecture contradictions
ideas.revenue_path: better quality and fewer mistakes before selling or delivering
ideas.margin_logic: use only for high-value reviews, not every small task
ideas.first_test: run one external review on product gates and task board, convert output into tasks

ideas.title: Universal Growth Campaign Engine
ideas.one_sentence_value: Create reusable campaign briefs for every product: target, pain, offer, CTA, budget, KPI and learning loop.
ideas.pain: outreach and ads can become disconnected from product gates and CFO logic
ideas.revenue_path: more structured lead generation and faster paid pilot testing
ideas.margin_logic: small tests first, scale only after reply or conversion signal
ideas.first_test: write first campaign brief for 299 EUR AI Automation Pilot
